description_en: Submits a task to modify registrant contact information by using a domain name registrant profile ID
description_zh: 通过信息模板编号提交修改注册联系人信息任务
name: SaveTaskForUpdatingRegistrantInfoByRegistrantProfileID

parameters.help_en: The IP address of the user. You can set this parameter to 127.0.0.1
parameters.name: user_client_ip

parameters.help_en:
The language of the error message returned by the API operation. Valid values:
zh: Chinese.
en: English.

Default value: en
parameters.help_zh:
接口返回错误信息语言。取值：
zh：中文。
en：英文。

默认为en
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The ID of the domain name registrant profile. You can call the QueryRegistrantProfiles (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/67701.htm?spm=a2c4g.11186623.0.0.33f420daTwRQaO) operation to query the profile ID
parameters.help_zh: 信息模板编号。您可以通过QueryRegistrantProfiles (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/67701.htm?spm=a2c4g.11186623.0.0.33f420daTwRQaO)接口查询信息模板编号
parameters.name: registrant_profile_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to add a transfer prohibition lock, which restricts the domain name from being transferred out within 60 days after the registrant is modified. Valid values:
false: Does not add the lock.
true: Adds the lock.

Default value: false
parameters.help_zh:
是否添加禁止转出限制，表示所有者修改后是否限制域名60天转出。取值：
false：不添加。
true：添加。

默认值为false
parameters.name: transfer_out_prohibited

parameters.help_en: The list of domain names. If multiple domain names are specified, pass them in a list. You can call the QueryDomainList (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69362.htm?spm=a2c4g.11186623.0.0.33f4253cSJy3m8) operation to obtain the domain name list
parameters.help_zh: 域名列表，多个域名时使用list方式传递。域名列表可通过QueryDomainList (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69362.htm?spm=a2c4g.11186623.0.0.33f4253cSJy3m8)接口获取
parameters.name: domain_name
